1. Touch target sizes — Hamburger menu (top right) - Icon is too small (≈32x32px, below 44x44px Apple HIG) (severity: HIGH)  
2. Touch target sizes — Chat button (bottom right) - Icon is too small (≈40x40px, below 44x44px) (severity: MED)  
3. Text readability — "Live 3D Preview" - Text is small but readable; no cut-off/overlap (severity: CLEAN)  
4. Horizontal overflow — No content extends beyond 390px viewport (severity: CLEAN)  
5. Layout breaks — No awkward stacking/gaps; elements align vertically (severity: CLEAN)  
6. Navigation — Hamburger menu visible and functional (severity: CLEAN)  
7. Forms — No visible forms on this screen (severity: CLEAN)  
8. Modals — No modals present (severity: CLEAN)  
9. Whitespace — Adequate spacing between elements (no cramping) (severity: CLEAN)  
10. Readability — Text contrast is sufficient; no tiny text (severity: CLEAN)  
11. Buttons — No buttons too close (only chat button, which is isolated) (severity: CLEAN)
